content: The test image shows mature soybean pods — brown, dried, somewhat shriveled/discolored. This looks like late-season pod disease. Key candidates: Diaporthe (pod and stem blight with black pycnidia on pods/stems) or Phomopsis (shriveled, dull seeds).

The pods in the test image are at the dry/mature stage with brownish discoloration and poor seed fill.
